entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who builds artifacts and the skyship Weatherlight to defeat the Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem who assists Urza.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The skyship Urza creates to defeat the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Thran Mana Rig
entities.description: A Thran structure in Shiv whose primary purpose Urza uncovers.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The place where the Thran Mana Rig stands.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Urza's academy, whose people battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island while he is away.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion Urza prepares to defeat.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane of the invaders, which Urza experiments to find a means of defeating.

events.summary: With Jhoira and Karn's help, Urza surveys the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncovers its primary purpose.
events.quote: With the assistance of his student Jhoira and Karn , the silver golem , Urza surveys the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncovers its primary purpose.

events.summary: While Urza is away, the people of the Tolarian Academy battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island.
events.quote: the people of his Tolarian Academy have to battle a Phyrexian infestation on the island itself.
